cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you hold this shelf bracket? I taught you a steadier grip than mine; let's see if you kept it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're finally keeping an eye on the time. One turn of that top screw and you can let go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. The other screws are lined up already.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good eye. Just tighten those, then slide the shelf on. I taught you to check your work before leaving it; I'll bring your coat.

reason: Stop crediting B with unstated screw preparation; praise its actual observation and use taught checking as the reason the small favor should include installing the shelf.
